scripts.build: npm run build:dist && npm run verify:preload
scripts.validate: npm run check:eol && npm run lint:css && node scripts/css-duplicate-selector-gate.js && node scripts/verify-i18n-completeness.js && npm run build:preload
scripts.verify:preload: node -e "var fs=require('fs');try{var sz=fs.statSync('dist/Component-preload.js').size;if(sz<50000){process.stderr.write('ERROR: Component-preload.js stub ('+sz+' bytes)\n');process.exit(1);}console.log('OK: Component-preload.js '+sz+' bytes');}catch(e){process.stderr.write('ERROR: dist/Component-preload.js missing — run npm run build:dist\n');process.exit(1);}"
